# Howth Technology Factory

> A small, sharp set of tools that each do one job well — usable by people in a browser, and by AI agents via MCP. Every tool is a standalone Apify Actor; screening/validation tools use official public data sources only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/): Overview of Howth Technology Factory and the full product grid.
- [About](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/about.html): Howth Technology Factory, what we build and where our tools are available.
- [Contact](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/contact.html): Get in touch with the team.
- [Privacy](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/privacy.html): How this site and our tools handle data.

## Products

- [Searchable product catalogue](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/): Human-readable catalogue organised by problem, buyer, product type, access method and AI-agent compatibility.
- [Machine-readable product catalogue](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/catalogue.json): Structured JSON inventory with stable product IDs, taxonomy facets, canonical pages and extensible shopfront arrays.

- [PDF Toolkit: Merge, Split, Compress & Convert PDFs](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/pdf-toolkit.html): Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs in one tool — batch jobs, no file-size limits. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/pdf-toolkit
- [EU VAT Validator (VIES): Verify & Bulk-Check VAT IDs](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/eu-vat-validator.html): Validate individual or bulk EU and Northern Ireland VAT numbers with the official VIES service. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/eu-vat-validator
- [Website Technology Detector: Tech Stack Scanner](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/tech-stack-detector.html): See what any website is built with — CMS, frameworks, analytics and more. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/tech-stack-detector
- [llms.txt Checker: AI Search Readiness Audit](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/llms-txt-checker.html): Audit any site's llms.txt and get an AI-readiness score with concrete fixes. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/llms-txt-checker
- [llms.txt Generator: Make Any Website AI-Readable](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/llms-txt-generator.html): Generate a ready-to-publish llms.txt so ChatGPT and AI agents can read your site. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/llms-txt-generator
- [llms.txt Checker, Generator & Monitor: AI Search Readiness](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/llms-txt-suite.html): Audit, generate and monitor your llms.txt in one — keep your site AI-readable. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/llms-txt-suite
- [Sanctions Screening: Check Names Against OFAC, EU, UK & UN](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/sanctions-screening.html): Screen names against official OFAC, EU, UK and UN sanctions lists — bulk, with match scores. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/sanctions-screening
- [IBAN Validator: Verify & Bulk-Check Bank IBANs](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/iban-validator.html): Validate IBANs offline against ISO 13616 — checksum, structure and SEPA coverage, single or bulk. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/iban-validator
- [Email & Domain Auth Checker: MX, SPF, DKIM & DMARC](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/email-domain-checker.html): Check MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records from DNS alone — spot disposable and role addresses too. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=apifmcpfactory/email-domain-checker

## Curated routes

- [Financial validation tools](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/solutions/financial-validation/): EU VAT and IBAN validation, with clear boundaries on what each check establishes.
- [AI visibility and llms.txt tools](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/solutions/ai-visibility/): Audit, generate and monitor llms.txt and related readiness signals.
- [Tools for developers and AI builders](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/for/developers-ai-builders/): APIs, MCP tools and focused workflow capabilities.
- [Tools for accountants and finance teams](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/for/accountants-finance/): PDF, VAT and IBAN tools for controlled finance workflows.
- [Product APIs](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/apis/): Current products with programmatic API access.
- [MCP tools](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/mcp-tools/): Current products available to compatible AI-agent workflows through MCP.

## Insights

- [Design VIES validation as a state machine](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/insights/vies-validation-state-machine.html): A practical workflow for preserving valid, invalid and temporarily unavailable VAT-validation outcomes.
- [Before automating PDF work, define the boundaries](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/insights/pdf-automation-boundaries.html): A practical checklist for PDF inputs, network policy, page semantics, outputs, retention, security and limits.
